about: What `level: -1` may name in `shown:`, command by command (issue #20, v0.117; docs/typst/report-engine.md §4): every key the command can print, in the order it prints them, axes written out -- a superset, a key the call does not print (alpha = 0, a round section, no stability) being accepted and ignored, and `eta_m_t`, `eta_m_c` printed in the order the side in interaction comes first. `parts` names the keys under a heading printed from level 2 only: at -1 the heading is printed where one of its keys is chosen. A check's verdicts are keys like any other, named by their utilisation -- `eta`, `eta_s`, `eta_y`, `eta_z`, `eta_m`, `eta_m_t`, `eta_m_c` --: at -1 a verdict is printed at the level `shown:` gives it and not at all where it names it not (issue #58, which retires the `results` of issue #39). Read by lib/calc-engine.typ (`level-plan`, which refuses a key not listed) and by calc/shown_variables.py (the switches the window offers); the keys of show-calc and show-connector-resistance are the export's own, and show-check-member's are member's and its check's together. Copied into a project with the engine (project.ENGINE_FILES).
